Talent: From The Shadows / Into The Light

From The Shadows: While in cover, gain 10 stacks per seconds up to 50. Each stack gives 1% Critical Hit Damage increase and 0.3% RPM. Buff only applies while out of cover. While out of cover, you will lose 2 stacks per seconds at normal speed and 1 stack per second if sprinting.

Into The Light: While out of cover and in combat, gain 10 stacks per seconds up to 50. Each stack gives 0.8% Armor Regen when consumed. Stacks are consumed at 10 stacks per second while in cover.

For each Core attribute, receive 40% of the other two Core Attributes' bonuses.Skill Tiers count as 15% Skill Efficiency when these attributes are applied.All pieces from this Gear Set, apart from the Backpack, will feature random Core Attributes

Healing Skills' Duration and Range are decreased by 75%, but their Healing Efficiency is increased by 100%.

Healing an Ally with a Skill will provide them 30% Hazard Protection for 10s. Cooldown per ally: 10s.
Increase the Healing Efficiency bonus from 100% to 150%.
Decrease the Duration and Range reduction from 75% to 25%.
Repairing an ally, increases their total weapon and skill damage by 3-20% for 10s. 1-15% if self. Effectiveness increased by your skill tier.
While at full armor, increases total skill repair by 160%.
Both you and Allies within 10m of you receive +40% Hazard Protection.
